content:
We have buyable reagents: p-toluenesulfonyl chloride (TsCl) is Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1, p-phenylenediamine (Nc1ccc(N)cc1), and cinnamoyl chloride (ClC(=O)/C=C/c1ccccc1). Need to propose retrosynthesis route with up to 3 steps. The target: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1.

We need to break into steps: maybe first form sulfonamide between p-toluenesulfonyl chloride and an aniline that already has the cinnamoyl amide attached? Actually target has sulfonyl attached to an aniline (p-tolyl sulfonyl attached to an aniline). The aniline is attached to the sulfonyl group and also to the aromatic ring (p-tolyl). The sulfonyl group is attached to a phenyl ring that bears the cinnamoyl amide substituent.

So we could think: Step 1: Couple p-toluenesulfonyl chloride with an aniline (the phenyl ring bearing the cinnamoyl amide). That aniline is 4-aminophenyl with the cinnamoyl amide substituent at para position? Actually the sulfonyl phenyl ring is c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. That's a phenyl ring with a trans-cinnamoyl amide substituent at para? The SMILES: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So the phenyl ring has the cinnamoyl amide at para relative to the sulfonyl attachment? The sulfonyl attaches at position 1 of that phenyl (via S(=O)(=O) to N). So the phenyl ring is attached via sulfonamide N to the sulfonyl group. The phenyl ring also has the cinnamoyl amide substituent at para (maybe). So we can think of building that phenyl ring with the amide first, then sulfonylate.

Thus retrosynthesis: Target -> disconnection of sulfonamide bond: break N-S bond to give sulfonyl chloride (TsCl) and aniline (the phenyl with cinnamoyl amide). That aniline is 4-(cinnamoylamido)aniline (p-aminophenyl cinnamamide). That can be made by amide formation between p-phenylenediamine (or 4-aminophenyl) and cinnamoyl chloride, then protecting the other amine? Actually we need an aniline with one amine free (to react with TsCl) and the other amide attached. Starting from p-phenylenediamine (both amines). If we acylate one amine with cinnamoyl chloride, we get monoacylated product (p-aminophenyl cinnamamide). That is our desired aniline. Then sulfonylate the remaining amine with TsCl to give target.

Thus two steps: Step 1: Acylation of p-phenylenediamine with cinnamoyl chloride (using base) to give 4-(cinnamoylamido)aniline. Step 2: Sulfonylation of that aniline with p-toluenesulfonyl chloride to give target.

We need to ensure that the order of steps is correct: final step is sulfonylation. So retrosynthesis: target -> (disconnection) sulfonamide bond -> TsCl + 4-(cinnamoylamido)aniline. Then 4-(cinnamoylamido)aniline -> (disconnection) amide bond -> p-phenylenediamine + cinnamoyl chloride.

Thus three leaf reagents: TsCl, p-phenylenediamine, cinnamoyl chloride. All buyable.

Now we need to find reaction templates IDs for these transformations. We can search template catalog. Let's search for sulfonylation of aniline with sulfonyl chloride.
